description:
pkix-revocation/src/crl.rs:376–384 vs 416–428

issuer_has_crl_sign() uses let-else on as_ref():

    let Some(exts) = cert.tbs_certificate.extensions.as_ref() else { return true; };

cert_is_ca_cert() uses as_deref().unwrap_or(&[]):

    cert.tbs_certificate.extensions.as_deref().unwrap_or(&[]).iter().find(...)

Both patterns are correct. Within the same file, two different idioms for the same 'extensions might be None' pattern add cognitive load for reviewers who must decide if there is a deliberate reason for the difference (there is not). Standardise on one pattern throughout crl.rs.
title: crl.rs: inconsistent extensions-None patterns (as_deref vs let-else)
